description: A blond-haired man who seems to be followed by destruction and disaster wherever he goes, Vash the Stampede is known to wander the land on his own. Although known to be an expert gunslinger who strangely refuses to take his opponents' lives, he is also somewhat of a comical figure—one who slips in and out of dangerous situations at his whim. Yet his vow to never kill remains puzzling to many. His invariably immense appetite always leads him into one twist after another. And in this new world, it results in many an adventure—such as saving on bullets in order to enjoy as many hotcakes and doughnuts as possible.
summon: Why grow up if you only grow more sentimental?
fusion: This land is made of LOVE and PEACE!
evolution: I plan to use this gun for world peace!
